title: The Child and the Greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven
description: The disciples ask Jesus who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven. Jesus places a child among them and says that one must turn around and become like a child to enter, and that whoever humbles themselves like this child is the greatest. He warns strongly against causing one of these little ones who believe in him to stumble – it would be better to have a millstone hung around your neck and be thrown into the sea. He urges to cut off your hand or foot, or tear out your eye, if it causes you to stumble. Finally, he warns against despising these little ones, for their angels in heaven always see the face of the Father.
